summary: All six requirements (REQ-1 through REQ-6) have been implemented. The diff shows comprehensive changes to backend types, frontend components, and export functionality. Free tier with 3 models/year is available, profile/subscription modals display both tiers, export limits (2 combined CSV/PDF exports) are enforced for free users, chart export buttons added to all three charts, and the dashboard header displays separate model and export usage for free tier users.
